title: Digital Events — Unified Operations Platform & Logistics Intelligence Agent
challenge: Digital Events managed production, receiving, shipping, and event coordination entirely through Slack, spreadsheets, and scattered tools. As the company grew, workflows became harder to manage: no single source of truth, production approvals lost in Slack threads, no unified event timeline, difficult onboarding for new hires, reactive firefighting across teams, and hours wasted hunting for updates. Leadership needed a modern, scalable operational foundation—without disrupting day-to-day work.
whyNow: More complexity in logistics and workflows
Lack of documentation to onboard growing teams
whyNowSummary: Without a centralized system, companies hit a growth ceiling: they can't scale without burning out staff or adding expensive headcount. This case study highlights how modern SMBs can evolve into the digital age—not by replacing tools, but by creating one operational brain that connects everything.
solution: A unified operations platform that becomes the company's home base, enabling: real-time operational visibility, production → receiving → shipping pipelines, Daily Brief published to Slack, alerts for risks/blockers/deadlines, automatic event timeline updates, a full digital coordinator that reduces manual workload, a centralized SSOT (Single Source of Truth) database, auto-generated SOPs/training/onboarding materials, and a lightweight company app experience for the entire org. This solution modernizes operations without forcing the team onto a new toolset.

Status of production, receiving, shipping, and equipment
Risk alerts (missing approvals, tight timelines, shipment delays)
Event timelines updated in real time
One place for leadership to see the day ahead

phases.name: Phase 2 — Logistics Agent
delivered: Tracks shipments and receiving in real time
Surfaces blockers before they become emergencies
phases.value: 1–3 hours saved across warehouse & EM teams daily, faster production & receiving turnaround, 30–40% fewer operational mistakes, creates a dependable rhythm across the organization

phases.name: Phase 3 — Digital Coordinator & Company App
delivered: Suggests workload balancing and resource allocation
Generates systems like SOPs, training, and onboarding materials in real time
Replaces tribal knowledge with structured, searchable data
Creates a product-agnostic company app powered by the SSOT

phases.value: Equivalent of 0.7–2 FTE in coordination and admin, consistent delivery (events on time, fewer fires), faster onboarding (from weeks to days), builds an operational asset that increases valuation

demoStory: A production update or receiving photo hits Slack → The system recognizes it → categorizes it → assigns ownership → updates the dashboard → updates the event timeline → includes it in the Daily Ops Brief → alerts responsible parties automatically → captures it for SOP/training documentation. The team does nothing differently—the system does the work.

outcome: Digital Events shifted from fragmented operations to a centralized operational intelligence platform that scales with growth, reduces stress, and creates durable organizational knowledge. This transformation demonstrates what is now possible for modern SMBs as they adopt AI-enabled operations.
